name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 82 - Am 168
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 83 a. Calls on the Council to suppress the transition allowances of former MEPs, Commissioners and the President of the European Council; asks for them to be able to apply for unemployment benefits in the same way as regular workers;
